headline: NFL Week 5 SNF: Ravens outlast Falcons 30-23 in overtime thriller
whyCareReason: Lamar Jackson leads 3-1 Baltimore into Mercedes-Benz Stadium while undefeated Vikings and 49ers defend 4-0 starts on Sunday.
teaser: Sunday Night Football kickoff is 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC in Atlanta. Unbeaten Vikings and 49ers headline the daytime slate.
story: In a breathtaking Sunday Night Football duel in Atlanta, the Baltimore Ravens survived a 30-23 overtime classic against the Falcons. After Michael Penix Jr. spearheaded an 80-yard fourth-quarter touchdown march to force extra time at 23-23, Baltimore executed a ten-play overtime drive capped by Tyler Huntley's goal-line quarterback sneak. On Atlanta's ensuing possession, All-Pro safety Kyle Hamilton produced a spectacular diving interception to preserve the victory. The win improves Baltimore to 4-1 atop the AFC North.
stakes: A victory cements Baltimore among the AFC elite, while Atlanta desperately seeks a signature win to climb into NFC South contention.
rivalryAngle: Two dynamic, dual-threat offensive schemes test contrasting defensive philosophies on primetime television.
funFacts: Mercedes-Benz Stadium features a unique eight-petal retractable pinwheel roof.
Lamar Jackson holds the highest winning percentage against NFC opponents of any active quarterback.
The Minnesota Vikings and San Francisco 49ers are both seeking to reach 5-0 during Sunday's afternoon games.

keyPlayers.name: Lamar Jackson

keyPlayers.name: Bijan Robinson
keyPlayers.hook: Dynamic playmaker capable of breaking games open through both the ground and air.

headToHead: Baltimore has won four of the last five meetings between the two franchises.
resultSummary: FINAL (OT): Ravens 30, Falcons 23 · Mercedes-Benz Stadium (Huntley TD, Hamilton INT in OT)
